AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry: Stain Removal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Crocheting of Personal Protective Equipment 16 4.2 Constructing Moist Bed Garden and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Crocheting Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Moist Bed Garden 15 Total Number of Lessons 120 NOTE: The suggested and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
